rationale.full_diff_row_threshold: Both in-scope root tables are below this threshold (CUSTOMER_MASTER 25,000; INVOICE_HEADER 18,750), so Tier 3 runs a FULL keyed diff on every root document rather than a sample. The 150,000 INVOICE_LINE rows are compared as embedded-array cardinality in Tier 1 and through their parent documents in Tier 3.
rationale.sample_size: Only used if a future unit exceeds the row threshold; recorded so the value is approved rather than defaulted.
rationale.numeric_abs_tol: Zero. Money is NUMBER(p,s) -> Decimal128 and precision is a contract, not a tolerance; any non-zero value here would let a rounding defect merge.
rationale.aggregate_rel_tol: Zero. Tier 2 aggregates are computed natively on each side over the same canonicalized values, so an exact match is achievable and any drift is a real defect.
rationale.source_concurrency: One. The source is a single Oracle Free container shared with the rest of the demo estate; concurrent extracts would contend for its budget and make timings non-reproducible.
